personality: 7 Dark-First Utility structure with 6 Glass / Luxe surfaces
personality_one_liner: A commanding, high-performance industrial marketplace that frames heavy machinery as cinematic, premium objects.

spacing.rule: Generous on imagery, tight and functional on metrics. Handle padding and margin correctly and subtle for buttons and components.

do's: Apply to sticky bottom Book/Bid bars with 96% opacity base.
Use on floating price tags over edge-to-edge truck photos.
Apply to modal scrims and bottom sheet headers.
dont's: Do not blur metric cards on the Owner Dashboard (use solid surfaceSecondary).
Do not blur form fields (use surfaceTertiary).

screens.name: Onboarding & Role Selection
screens.purpose: Assigns user as Renter (Trucker) or Owner, utilizing a cinematic 3D truck backdrop with glassmorphic cards.
screens.layout: Full-bleed background image (`hero_truck_2`) with a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to #0F0F12). At the bottom 40%, two large glass cards (flex column) for 'I am a Trucker' and 'I am an Owner'.

screens.name: Driver License Verification
screens.purpose: Camera capture for ID with AI scanning overlay for expiry/details extraction.

states.loading: Scanning animation: glowing brandPrimary line sweeping up/down the frame.
states.empty: Placeholder illustration of a license inside the camera frame bounds.
states.error: Blurry or expired ID - red border, error text, 'Retake Photo' primary CTA.

screens.layout: Camera view full screen. A cutout rectangle (surfaceSecondary at 80% opacity around it) defines the ID bounds. Once captured, a bottom sheet slides up showing extracted data (Name, Expiry, Class) with a 'Confirm & Proceed' button.

screens.name: Marketplace (Renter Home)
screens.purpose: Browse and search available trucks/trailers with a premium, photo-led UI.

states.loading: Skeleton cards with subtle shimmer on surfaceSecondary.
states.empty: Illustration of an empty garage + 'No rigs available for these dates' + 'Clear Filters'.
states.error: Failed to load marketplace + Retry CTA.

screens.layout: Sticky header with Location/Dates and horizontal scrolling pill chips (Box, Flatbed, Reefer). Vertical list of hero cards. Each card is full-bleed width minus md padding. Large 3D truck photo (240pt high), bottom gradient scrim, with title, specs, and a glass-backed price tag floating bottom-left.

screens.name: Listing Detail
screens.purpose: Deep dive into truck specs, load entry, and commission split transparency.
screens.layout: Top edge-to-edge photo carousel (300pt). Title and specs below in solid surface. A structured 'Load Details' input section. A 'Commission Split' breakdown module using brandTertiary bars showing App Cut vs Owner Majority. Sticky bottom bar (glass) with total price and 'Book Rig' CTA.

screens.name: Owner Dashboard
screens.purpose: Command center for fleet owners to track active rentals and earnings.

states.empty: Illustration of a key + 'List your first rig'.

screens.layout: Dark-First Utility layout. Top grid of metric cards (Earnings, Active, Pending). List of 'Incoming Bookings' with approve/decline swipe actions. High data density, strong typography hierarchy using Rajdhani for numbers.

screens.name: Maintenance & Tow Bidding
screens.purpose: Marketplace for truckers to post breakdowns and tow companies to bid.

states.empty: Illustration of a wrench + 'No active requests'.

screens.layout: List of active issues (e.g., 'Flat tire - I-95 Mile 42'). Tap to view 'Bids'. Bids appear as a sorted list (lowest first). Each bid row shows Company Name, ETA, and Price, with an 'Accept' button.

hero_truck_2.alt: 3D Render of modern truck on dark background

instructions_to_main_agent: Premium Imagery First: Do not wrap the main truck images in heavy card borders. Let them bleed to the edges or have minimal padding (md). Use a gradient scrim (top to bottom, transparent to #0F0F12) overlaying the bottom 30-40% of the image so that text/price reads perfectly.
Dark-First Utility execution: Metric numbers (earnings, capacity, split numbers) should use the Rajdhani display font for an industrial, precise look. Body text stays in Manrope.
Bidding UI: Sort bids by cheapest automatically. Emphasize the cheapest bid with a subtle brandTertiary background or highlight.
Camera Overlay: For the DL scan, use an absolute positioned view with a cutout or border frame indicating where to place the license.

Component Status: Follow <CRITICAL_RULES> strictly—no emojis in system UI, no indigo/blue/purple default colors (we are using Industrial Orange #FF6B00), and always implement Loading/Empty/Error states on data screens.
